name: Shepit Za Viknom
source:
Lina’s dream of becoming a witch begins with a lonely room and an eerie visitor at night. Whispers call her to open the window – but what waits outside?

[From [url=https://nimbuspawtales.itch.io/the-whisper-beyond-the-window-jam6]Itch.io[/url]]
